mediaWork.title: Who Killed Garrett Phillips?
mediaWork.summaryNotes: A two-part documentary series exploring the case of 12-year-old Garrett Phillips, who was murdered in 2011, and the subsequent trial of Oral "Nick" Hillary, a black man living in a mostly white community.
